headline: Stock market on September 28: Cash flow moves to the oil and gas group
summary: Vietnam's stock market opened the week with widespread selling, but stronger buying into the close narrowed the index decline. Oil and gas was the most prominent group, supporting the market.
why: The VN-Index tracks the main listed stocks on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange, the key benchmark for Vietnamese equities.
